claim: The interrupt spec states IRQ 4 PER FRAME (1 IN VBLANK) — the same wording Centipede carries; game logic runs once per video frame.
VBLANK is bit D6 of ENDSCREEN (VBLANK =2000) — the flag the IRQ tests to pick out the one-in-four VBLANK interrupt.
The IRQ handler distinguishes the VBLANK pass by testing that D6 flag: BIT VBLANK.
BVS branches when the machine is in VBLANK (WE ARE IN VBLANK), so the once-per-frame logic hangs off this branch.
